text_block_list.text: For a change of pace, I instructed Satono Diamond to go for a run around town today, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What a huge crowd... I wonder if there's some kind of event being held nearby?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...No, no, this won't do.
I'm in the middle of training right now, so I have to get back to the academy quickly—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me.
Could you please let me through...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"This is... the 'Heaven and Earth Crane Game Tournament'?
Did this crowd gather just to watch that...?"

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Welcome. Are you looking to participate,
or are you here to watch?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, the thing is... I...

And so, in the end, Satono Diamond
skipped out on training.
...In exchange for a giant championship trophy.
